research_notes: Blocked after official career list, employer RAP and historical ownership release, water report, personal biography, first speech and targeted professional-profile/FTE searches. Need full communications chronology, individual hours, direct Transdev employing entity and 2022–23 gap coverage.
2017 scholarship and 2019 RAP are point-in-time role evidence, not appointment start/end dates. Transdev work is nested in the2015–19 umbrella entry and must not be counted twice.

Transdev's public-transport contracts alone do not establish sector; historical corporate control does. The2019 primary release establishes French public control at that date, while the whole employment interval remains unresolved.
Speech describes sister Clara's parliamentary, court and property-law career; none is assigned to Alice. Neuroscience study, parents' rail work and husband's apprenticeship are not her employment.
A secondary site converts year labels to1January dates; those artificial boundaries were rejected. Melbourne Water month dates retained without a new duration convention or invented FTE.

Follow-up2026-10-02: added previously omitted teenage hospitality and bus-depot work; identified hospital volunteering, with explicit caution reconciling it to official year range. Transdev2016 accounts resolve parent sole-control transition.

Follow-up2026-10-03: adopted the public professional-profile mirror's May2017–June2019 Transdev title sequence because primary 2017 and2019 sources independently corroborate employer and role observations within it. The mirror alone supplies exact month boundaries, so hours, transitions and full-time status remain unverified; the broader official2015–19 communications interval may include another employer.

Searched personal biography, first-speech transcript, published career survey, public profiles and historical parent accounts. Professional-profile mirror boundaries are retained with an explicit sole-source caveat and corroborating point observations, not treated as proof of full-time status. Saturday Paper direct open403; used indexed excerpt. Later OpenAustralia speech returned Internal Error; earlier transcript accessible. Staff job ads do not evidence her own FTE.

Next leads: burger business name and traineeship dates, depot employer and overlap, direct Transdev employing subsidiary/contracts and hours, Melbourne Water hours, remaining ministerial assignments and2022–23 gap. No full-time total defensible.

Follow-up2026-10-04: targeted searches for remaining ministerial-office assignments, Melbourne Water employment status, Transdev employing entity, the burger traineeship and bus-depot employer produced only the current official aggregate chronology, the previously recorded public professional-profile mirror and broad campaign biographies. Searches pairing Jordan-Baird with James Merlino and Melissa Horne did not recover a second appointment instrument or post-May2020 assignment. No employer, boundary or full-time status was inferred from contemporary staff job advertisements or derivative profiles.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Added previously omitted Melbourne science/neuroscience study. Own and official biographies corroborate the subject/institution;2013–2016 attendance labels come only from the already recorded public profile mirror and retain that limitation. Targeted primary/public-profile education and full-time searches did not recover independent attendance/conferral dates or individual employment hours. Other people’s professional-profile education and her staff recruitment advertisements were rejected as evidence of her own history. Remaining employer/traineeship,2022–23 coverage and payroll gaps unchanged.

Follow-up2026-10-05: Both search engines targeted earliest communications employer, Melbourne Water hours, 2022–23 gap and burger traineeship. A June2026 first-person Hansard statement corroborates teenage burger work as her first job but still names no employer or dates/hours; retained as nonmaterial corroboration. Current staff recruitment and apprenticeship-program full-time labels concern other workers, not her. Public Transdev colleague acknowledgement is only affiliation context, not employing-subsidiary or FTE proof; direct LinkedIn open returned999 Unknown Status Code. Primary biographies repeat existing aggregate intervals. Remaining gaps need individual appointment/payroll evidence and identified early employers; no new duration calculated.
